import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static int n, m;
    static long[] a;
    static List<Long> a1List = new ArrayList<>();
    static List<Long> a2List = new ArrayList<>();
    static int n1;

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        if (!sc.hasNextInt()) return;
        n = sc.nextInt();
        m = sc.nextInt();
        a = new long[n];
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            a[i] = sc.nextLong();
        }
        n1 = n / 2;

        sums1(0, 0);
        sums2(n1, 0);

        // Use a TreeSet to get unique sorted elements for a1
        Set<Long> setA1 = new TreeSet<>(a1List);
        long[] a1 = new long[setA1.size()];
        int idx = 0;
        for (long val : setA1) {
            a1[idx++] = val;
        }

        long ans = 0;
        for (long i : a2List) {
            long target = m - i;
            int j = Collections.binarySearch(Arrays.asList(wrapLongs(a1)), target);
            
            // bisect_left logic:
            // If target is found, j is the index.
            // If not found, j is (-(insertion point) - 1).
            int pos = j >= 0 ? j : -j - 1;
            
            // The Python code uses a1[j-1]. 
            // If pos is 0, j-1 is -1. In Python, a1[-1] is the last element.
            int index = pos - 1;
            if (index < 0) {
                index = a1.length - 1;
            }
            
            if (index >= 0 && index < a1.length) {
                long currentSum = a1[index] + i;
                if (ans < currentSum) {
                    ans = currentSum;
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(ans);
    }

    static void sums1(int i, long sum) {
        if (i == n1) {
            a1List.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums1(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            sums1(i + 1, sum);
        }
    }

    static void sums2(int i, long sum) {
        if (i == n) {
            a2List.add(sum);
        } else {
            sums2(i + 1, (sum + a[i]) % m);
            sums2(i + 1, sum);
        }
    }
    
    // Helper to allow binarySearch on primitive array via List wrapper
    static List<Long> wrapLongs(long[] arr) {
        List<Long> list = new ArrayList<>(arr.length);
        for (long l : arr) list.add(l);
        return list;
    }
}
